ratio = x / y
best_pair = (0, 1)
smallest_diff = float('inf')

for denominator in range(1, n + 1):
    approximate = ratio * denominator
    numerator_floor = int(approximate)
    numerator_ceil = numerator_floor + 1

    diff_floor = abs(ratio - numerator_floor / denominator)
    diff_ceil = abs(numerator_ceil / denominator - ratio)

    if diff_floor < smallest_diff:

        best_pair = (numerator_floor, denominator)
    if diff_ceil < smallest_diff:
        smallest_diff = diff_ceil
        best_pair = (numerator_ceil, denominator)
